metadata.description: Frontend Developer with over four years building enterprise applications for the energy and financial sectors with React, TypeScript and Next.js.

paragraphs: For over four years I've been building enterprise applications for the energy and financial sectors.
Today I'm the sole frontend owner of a product in YPF's Mobile unit: from architecture and the component system to implementation and maintenance.
I have experience modernizing legacy applications into current React and TypeScript stacks, working closely with backend, UX and business teams.

contact.lead: Have a role or a project in mind? Write to me and I'll get back to you shortly.

cda.summary: Frontend development of enterprise applications for clients in the energy and financial sectors: YPF, Banco Galicia, Itaú and Macro.

nexplan.title: NexPlan
nexplan.summary: A product built from scratch for YPF's Mobile unit.
highlights: Frontend architecture defined together with a senior developer; today I'm the only frontend developer on the project.
Component library built from scratch with styled-components from the UX designs, intended as the base template for the company's upcoming products.
Gradually taking on .NET backend work: bug fixing and endpoint development.

iap.title: IAP — Project Management System
iap.summary: A system to manage the company's active projects across their administrative, accounting and budget dimensions.
highlights: Migration of an existing .NET 2.1 application to a modern architecture with a React frontend and a .NET BFF, with roughly 90% of the frontend under my ownership.
Designed every view and the interaction flow in Figma, covering for the lack of an assigned UX designer.
Custom components built on MUI with a tailored theme.

financial.title: Financial sector
financial.summary: Interfaces for banks built with React, TypeScript and Next.js, with unit tests in Jest.
highlights: Built interfaces with React, TypeScript and Next.js, covered by unit tests in Jest.
Contributed to Banco Galicia's debtor information system.
